entry: PuzzleText.mount(opts)  // opts all optional; defaults drive the tx5 DOM ids, or pass { paragraph, renderSrc, renderSide, ... }
rules: words always opaque — opacity stays 1; assembly is transform + color only (gray -> ink) => zero layout shift
gray -> ink as each word seats; farther-from-home = lighter gray + larger + more rotate/skew
scatter is wide diagonal on BOTH axes, CONTAINED to the column (xBias keeps debris OFF the render slab)
split is word-level only (letters banned, D12)
paired with a big contained QUADRO render (~45vw) on one side, statement in the facing cream column
GPU transform / opacity / color only — no WebGL, no video.currentTime, no mix-blend / backdrop over the scrub
scroll-scrubbed + pinned => fully reversible (scroll back re-scatters)
reduced-motion / narrow => static readable paragraph, render stacks above, no scatter, no pin

renderSide.meaning: which side the contained render slab sits on; the scatter x-bias mirrors to keep debris off the slab

renderSrc.meaning: the paired render url painted onto the slab (else the DOM author's background)

paragraph.meaning: JS-driven statement copy (else the DOM author's content is kept)

maxY.meaning: max vertical scatter reach (+/-); wide diagonal, both axes

xSpread.meaning: how much of maxX is signed random spread (tx5: x = (dx*xSpread + biasSign*xBias) * maxX)

xBias.meaning: inward push of the scatter toward the column interior so gray debris never crosses onto the render slab

rotate.meaning: max per-word rotation in scattered state

skew.meaning: max per-word skewX (italic-drift feel) in scattered state

scaleFar.meaning: scale of the farthest word (farther-from-home = larger; near = 1.0)

ghostNear.meaning: scattered tint of the nearest word (darker gray)

ghostFar.meaning: scattered tint of the farthest word (lighter gray)

ease.meaning: the one air ease (CustomEase 0.25,0.74,0.22,0.99; fallback power4.out)

scrub.meaning: ScrollTrigger scrub smoothing of the reversible scatter<->assemble move

pinPct.meaning: pin scroll length of the scrubbed scatter<->assemble move (end:'+=pinPct%')
